recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If a future review wants broader Excel normalization beyond the originally applied getColumn behavior, that follow-up should be handled in the external Java tooling repositories (Kindling/org.hl7.fhir.core), not as a FHIR core source edit.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core tooling request to convert non-breaking spaces and tabs into ordinary whitespace when processing Excel spreadsheet content before trimming/parsing.
initial_application: Jira records svn 14523. Git commit 6e138bd162989d4af9bc146155f9f69e1eed13e8 maps to that revision and changed XLSXmlParser.getColumn from plain trim() to trim().replace("\t", "  ").replace("\u00A0", " "). Commit 213590de6f6e23bd8d14f05cee02fe6e9272f0be also used GF#16955 for a spreadsheet comment correction, but the parser commit is the substantive application.
additional_context: The current FHIR checkout contains no Java source files or XLSXmlParser.java. Its build delegates publishing to org.hl7.fhir:kindling via build.gradle.kts, with kindlingVersion=1.25.5-SNAPSHOT in gradle.properties. The current external org.hl7.fhir.utilities XLSXmlParser in hapifhir/org.hl7.fhir.core preserves the tab and U+00A0 replacement in getColumn. Confluence minutes from the 2018-07-30 FHIR Infrastructure call list tracker 16955 as Persuasive, and no conflicting community evidence was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No FHIR source edit is needed because the source-owned parser changed by FHIR-16955 no longer lives in this checkout and the active external parser already contains the requested normalization.
